presentation.speaker: ms_okoro
presentation.title: Subsidy policy change
lines: The city is halving solar grants. File rush paperwork for applications still in the queue, or accept the lower rate.

choices.label: Pay rush filing fees to protect pending grants
choices.outcome: Pending applications keep the old grant; new ones pay half for 90 days.

choices.label: Accept the cut and requote clients
choices.outcome: Every grant is halved while the policy recovers over 90 days.
